children: Central Plaza Hotel's 3Q core earnings are likely to expand, Maybank Securities (Thailand) analyst Boonyakorn Amornsank says in a report. The hotel and restaurant chain operator's Thailand hotel business is expected to deliver a revenue growth of at least 15% on year per available room, partly driven by demand from short-haul tourists. Its Maldives business's revenue per available room should also grow by at least 30%, thanks to a low base. Maybank maintains a hold rating on the stock and a target price of 40.00 baht. Shares are up 1.1% at 45.00 baht.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
